scope: Foreign full-time monthly-paid workers in the federal private-sector traditional gratuity system; continuous service only; amounts before deductions.
cap_status: Unresolved official wording: Article 51(6) says two years wage; a MOHRE job-offer annex search excerpt says two years basic wage. This model rejects accrual above 24 months basic rather than deciding which cap applies.
rounding: Calculate unrounded accrual then round the displayed total once to the nearest fils, half up; display convention pending official worked-example review.
